6.72 rsInvalidDefaultValueValues
rsInvalidDefaultValueValues is a non-critical error that will occur when a
ReportParameter.DefaultValue contains a Values collection that has more than one Values.Value
element. For single-valued parameters, only the first Values.Value element in the Values collection
is used.
